paras: Cyrtodactylus kingsadai is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, kingsadai, is in honor of Laotian herpetologist Phouthone Kingsada (died 2012).
C. kingsadai is found in southern Vietnam, in Phu Yen Province.
The preferred natural habitat of C. kingsadai is shrubland, at altitudes of 50–100 m (160–330 ft).
Medium-sized for its genus, C. kingsadai may attain a snout-to-vent length of 9.4 cm (3.7 in).
The mode of reproduction of C. kingsadai is unknown.
